encounter_and_evolution_timing.notes: Pokémon are introduced according to their earliest verified encounter and evolution availability. Do not display a final evolution before its level or evolution condition is met.

mega_stone_availability.notes: Mega Stones and special transformation items are assigned only after their corresponding story, side mission, or encounter unlock.

held_item_sources.notes: Temporary held items use identified sources. Unique rewards must not be assigned to multiple Pokémon simultaneously. Mega Stones and Primal Orbs occupy the held-item slot.

main_game_move_progression.notes: This revision adds specific level-up, evolution, and available move recommendations by phase. Further refinement can incorporate every move source and exact acquisition timing.

every_tm_earliest_acquisition_and_compat.notes: The exhaustive TM reference is intentionally pending. Each TM still needs its earliest acquisition condition and compatibility cross-check against every recommended Pokémon.

dlc_endgame_roster_and_mission_sequence.notes: The DLC roster is introduced progressively. Hyperspace Missions 12 to 14 are postgame content, and Mega Lucario Z is tied to Side Mission 197.

phases.name: Phase 1 · Missions 1–5
phases.goal: Establish the starter and early utility Pokémon without assuming access to later zones or research rewards.
phases.research: Research Level is a flexible target. Complete the requests and research tasks actually unlocked at this point. Do not require Level 14 in this phase.
rows: Totodile
Choose as the starter Pokémon.
Water Gun (Lv6) / Bite (Lv10). Add Bubble Beam at Lv15 when reached.
Natural level-up progression. Do not assume later TMs are already available.
Quick Claw (temporary)
Gift from the woman at the stall southeast of Vert Sector 2. One confirmed copy; prioritize the active lead.
Fletchling
Catch in an accessible early Wild Zone when available.
Peck / Quick Attack (Lv8) / Ember (Lv12).
Natural level-up progression. Feather Dance at Lv16 is a later upgrade.
No dedicated item
Keep the slot open or use an available temporary item. Do not duplicate the Quick Claw.

phases.name: Phase 2 · Missions 6–10
phases.goal: Expand the team as additional Wild Zones become accessible and prepare the starter and early captures for their next evolutions.
phases.research: Aim for the highest Research Level supported by currently unlocked task categories. Level 14 is optional, not a phase requirement.
rows: Croconaw

Water Gun / Bite / Bubble Beam (Lv15) / Slash (on evolution).
Level-up and evolution moves. Aqua Jet becomes available at Lv21.
Oran Berry (temporary)
Side Mission 20: Berry Clever Plan. Reward includes Oran Berry ×10.
Ralts → Kirlia
Catch Ralts when its encounter area becomes accessible. Evolves at Level 20.
Confusion (Lv6) / Draining Kiss (Lv12) / Psybeam (Lv18) / Magical Leaf (Lv20).
Natural level-up progression. Review moves after evolution.
Wise Glasses (temporary)
Side Mission 21: Spewpa in Museum. One confirmed copy.
Houndour
Catch when its encounter area becomes accessible.
Ember / Roar (Lv13) / Bite (Lv16) / Take Down (Lv24).
Natural level-up progression. Do not assign Houndoom-only Snarl to Houndour.
Oran Berry (temporary)
Use another berry from the Side Mission 20 reward if available.
Drilbur
Catch when Wild Zone 9 becomes accessible after Main Mission 9.
Mud Shot / Metal Claw (Lv7) / Sand Tomb (Lv13) / Bulldoze (Lv18).
Natural level-up progression. Dig becomes available at Lv28.
Soft Sand (temporary)
Side Mission 23: Underneath the Holovator. Use when obtained.

phases.name: Phase 3 · Missions 11–18
phases.goal: Develop the main battle core and add the Pokémon needed for later Mega-focused progression.
phases.research: Use Mable's Research reward track as an unlock list. Claim rewards only when the corresponding level is actually reached.
rows: Feraligatr
Croconaw evolves at Level 30.
Water STAB / Crunch (on evolution) / Breaking Swipe (Lv26) / strongest currently available coverage.
Crunch is an evolution move. Liquidation is a natural Lv40 move, not an early-phase assumption.
Feraligite (when acquired)
Use only after obtaining the Mega Stone. It replaces any other held item.
Gardevoir
Kirlia evolves at Level 30.
Dazzling Gleam (on evolution) / Calm Mind (Lv35) when reached / strongest available Psychic move.
Dazzling Gleam is learned on evolution. Psychic is learned at Lv38.
Wise Glasses (temporary)
Side Mission 21 reward. Replace with Gardevoirite once acquired.
Lucario
Catch Riolu when its encounter or request becomes available. Evolve through friendship.
Metal Claw (Lv8) / Work Up (Lv16) / Aura Sphere (Lucario Lv25) / Bulldoze (Lv28).
Aura Sphere belongs to Lucario, not Riolu. Use the move reminder for eligible moves when needed.
Soothe Bell (temporary)
Side Mission 36 reward when unlocked. Useful while building friendship.
Houndour → Houndoom
Houndour evolves at Level 24.
Fire Fang (Lv28) / Dark Pulse (Houndoom Lv34) / strongest available Dark and Fire STAB.
Snarl is a Houndoom level-up move, not a Houndour Lv21 move. Flamethrower is learned at Lv44.
Oran Berry (temporary)
Side Mission 20 reward. Replace with Houndoominite when acquired.

phases.name: Phase 4 · Missions 19–24
phases.goal: Complete the Ground and Steel role and upgrade the existing core with moves that are genuinely available by this point.
phases.research: Do not force a fixed Research Level. Prioritize newly unlocked research categories, requests, and mission rewards.
rows: Excadrill
Evolve the Drilbur obtained earlier when it reaches Level 31.
Dig (Lv28) / Rock Slide (Lv32) / Swords Dance (Lv36) / Drill Run (Lv40).
Natural level-up progression. Earthquake is learned at Lv46 or can be taught by TM069 after Research Level 34.
Soft Sand (temporary)
Side Mission 23: Underneath the Holovator. Replace only if a more suitable confirmed item is available.
Gardevoir
Continue the established Kirlia evolution line.
Dazzling Gleam / Psychic (Lv38 when reached) / Calm Mind (Lv35 when reached) / available coverage.
Natural level-up and evolution moves. TM options must be checked against actual Research Level and TM compatibility.
Twisted Spoon (temporary)
Side Mission 35 reward when available. Replace with Gardevoirite when acquired.
Lucario
Continue the established Riolu evolution line.
Aura Sphere (Lv25) / Bulldoze (Lv28) / Metal Sound (Lv32, move reminder) / Swords Dance (Lv35).
Lucario level-up and reminder moves. Close Combat is learned at Lv54.
Black Belt (if acquired)
Side Mission 58 reward. Otherwise retain Soothe Bell or another available item.
Feraligatr
Continue the starter line.
Crunch / Aqua Jet (Lv21) / Breaking Swipe (Lv26) / strongest available Water move.
Crunch is learned on evolution. Liquidation is not available naturally until Lv40.
Feraligite (when acquired)
Mega Stone replaces all other held items.

phases.name: Phase 5 · Missions 25–31
phases.goal: Add the Dragon line and prepare the team for the late main-game battles.
phases.research: Use earned Mable Research levels for their actual TM rewards. Do not assume later research rewards are available early.
rows: Dratini → Dragonair
Catch Dratini when its encounter area is accessible. Evolves into Dragonair at Level 30.
Twister (Lv5) / Thunder Wave (Lv10) / Breaking Swipe (Lv20) / Dragon Rush (Lv30).
Natural level-up progression. Do not list Dragonite-only evolution moves before Dragonite is obtained.
Dragon Fang (temporary)
Use only once obtained. Do not assume a Mega Stone for this line.
Feraligatr
Keep as the primary Water attacker.
Crunch / Aqua Jet / Liquidation (Lv40 when reached) / Ice Fang if available.
Liquidation is learned naturally at Lv40. TM076 Liquidation is an alternative after Wild Zone 16 opens following Mission 24.
Feraligite
Mega Stone; occupies the held-item slot.
Gardevoir
Continue the established line.
Psychic (Lv38) / Dazzling Gleam / Mystical Fire (Lv44 when reached) / Calm Mind.
Natural level-up and evolution moves. Mystical Fire is not assumed before its level requirement.
Gardevoirite
Use once acquired; otherwise retain Wise Glasses or Twisted Spoon.
Lucario
Continue the established line.
Aura Sphere / Swords Dance / Dragon Pulse (Lv38) / strongest available Steel move.
Natural level-up and reminder moves. Do not assign Close Combat before its Lv54 requirement.
Lucarionite
Use once acquired; otherwise retain an appropriate temporary item.

phases.name: Phase 6 · Missions 32–37
phases.goal: Complete the main-story battle roster with the strongest practical moves available before the postgame.
phases.research: Claim the highest Research Level reached naturally. High-level TMs have explicit thresholds; do not assume Level 50 is already achieved.
rows: Feraligatr
Keep as the Water attacker. Mega Evolve when appropriate.
Liquidation / Crunch / Ice Fang / Rock Slide.
Liquidation is available by Lv40 or TM076 after Wild Zone 16 opens. Check TM compatibility and actual unlocks for the other moves.
Feraligite
Mega Stone; replaces all other held items.
Gardevoir
Keep as the Psychic and Fairy special attacker. Mega Evolve when appropriate.
Psychic / Moonblast / Mystical Fire / Calm Mind.
Psychic Lv38, Mystical Fire Lv44, and the other moves through verified level-up, evolution, or compatible TM sources.
Gardevoirite
Mega Stone; replaces Wise Glasses or Twisted Spoon.
Lucario
Keep as the Fighting and Steel attacker. Mega Evolve when appropriate.
Close Combat / Bullet Punch / Extreme Speed / Swords Dance.
Close Combat is learned at Lv54 and Extreme Speed at Lv45. Verify the move reminder for eligible moves.
Lucarionite
Mega Stone; replaces Soothe Bell or Black Belt.
Excadrill
Keep for Ground and Steel coverage.
Earthquake / Drill Run / Rock Slide / Swords Dance.
Earthquake is learned at Lv46 or can be taught through TM069 after Research Level 34. Other moves require their level or TM unlock.
Soft Sand
Temporary Ground damage item. Do not assume an Excadrill Mega Stone.
Dragonite
Evolve Dratini through Dragonair at the appropriate levels. Dragonair evolves at Level 55.
Outrage / Hurricane / Extreme Speed / Dragon Rush.
Hurricane is learned on Dragonite's evolution. Outrage and Extreme Speed have level-up requirements. Do not list Dragon Dance as a verified Z-A level-up move.
Dragon Fang
Temporary Dragon damage item. Do not assign a Mega Stone unless a verified Z-A source is obtained.
Houndoom
Keep for Fire and Dark coverage.
Dark Pulse / Flamethrower / Overheat / Nasty Plot.
Dark Pulse Lv34, Flamethrower Lv44, Overheat Lv55, and Nasty Plot through its verified level-up progression.
Houndoominite
Mega Stone; replaces Wise Glasses or any other held item.

phases.name: Phase 7 · Postgame · Missions 38–42
phases.goal: Complete postgame content, claim available special encounters, and prepare for Mega Dimension.
phases.research: Continue toward the final Mable Research rewards. Research Level 50 is a completion objective, not a mandatory story-phase gate.
rows: Xerneas (special)
Mystery Gift password: CELEBRATE30TH. Claim while the distribution is active and Mystery Gift is accessible.
Geomancy / Moonblast / Thunderbolt / Focus Blast.
Moves are supplied with the special Level 100 Mystery Gift Xerneas. Retain its supplied moves unless a deliberate replacement is preferred.
Appropriate damage or utility item
Use a confirmed available item. Xerneas does not use a Mega Stone in this recommendation.
Main-game core
Retain Feraligatr, Gardevoir, Lucario, Excadrill, Dragonite, and Houndoom according to matchup needs.
Use the Phase 6 movesets as the baseline and upgrade only with confirmed level-up, reminder, or compatible TM moves.
Confirm the exact TM acquisition and compatibility before assigning any TM-only move.
Available Mega Stones
A Mega Stone occupies the held-item slot. A Pokémon cannot hold a Mega Stone and a second item simultaneously.
Mega Dimension preparation
DLC content becomes available after completing the required main-game progression and starting the DLC request.
Keep the strongest main-game movesets while preparing for Hyperspace battles.
DLC-exclusive moves and TMs should be added only after their actual unlock and compatibility are confirmed.
Best available temporary items
Do not allocate DLC Mega Stones before their corresponding Hyperspace mission or side mission reward.

phases.name: Phase 8 · Mega Dimension DLC
phases.goal: Progress through the DLC in its actual encounter order and build toward the intended six-Pokémon endgame roster.
phases.research: Use the DLC research and Hyperspace task list as it becomes available. Do not assume every DLC encounter is available at the start of Phase 8.
rows: Darkrai → Mega Darkrai
Catch during Hyperspace Mission 11: Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 6.
Use Darkrai's verified Z-A level-up and compatible TM moves. Build around its special attacking role.
Confirm each move in the in-game move menu. Do not assume its final moveset before the encounter.
Darkranite
Obtained after the Rogue Mega Darkrai encounter in Hyperspace Mission 11.
Primal Groudon
Catch during Hyperspace Mission 13: A Ruby-Red Legend.
Use its verified Ground and Fire coverage, prioritizing compatible high-power moves.
Confirm move access and TM compatibility after catching Groudon.
Red Orb
Obtained through Hyperspace Mission 13. The Orb enables its Primal Reversion.
Primal Kyogre
Catch during Hyperspace Mission 14: A Sapphire-Blue Legend.
Use its verified Water special-attacking moves and compatible coverage.
Confirm move access and TM compatibility after catching Kyogre.
Blue Orb
Obtained through Hyperspace Mission 14. The Orb enables its Primal Reversion.
Mega Rayquaza
Catch during Hyperspace Mission 12: The Greatest Gift, after completing Hyperspace Missions 13 and 14.
Use its verified Dragon and Flying moves and compatible coverage.
Confirm its available moves after catching it. Do not assume the encounter is available before the Groudon and Kyogre missions are completed.
No separate Mega Stone
Mega Rayquaza's Mega Evolution uses its special move requirement rather than a held Mega Stone.
Mega Lucario Z
Use the established Lucario and complete Side Mission 197: Ultra-Hardcore Lucario Showdown!
Retain a strong Fighting and Steel moveset, then optimize for the Z Mega form.
Use verified Lucario level-up, move reminder, and compatible TM options.
Lucarionite Z
Reward for completing Side Mission 197. This is separate from the standard Lucarionite.
Mega Mewtwo Y
Obtain Mewtwo through the Project M special side mission after the required DLC and postgame progression.
Use its verified Psychic special-attacking moves and compatible coverage.
Confirm the available moves after obtaining Mewtwo. Do not assume it is available at the start of the DLC.
Mewtwonite Y
Use the Mega Stone associated with the Project M reward sequence once obtained.
Final six-Pokémon roster
Primal Kyogre / Mega Mewtwo Y / Mega Lucario Z / Mega Rayquaza / Primal Groudon / Mega Darkrai.
Optimize each moveset using verified Z-A level-up moves, move reminders, and compatible base-game or DLC TMs.
The final TM-by-TM reference must be completed before treating every recommended move as an acquisition-ready instruction.
Species-specific transformation item
Use Blue Orb, Mewtwonite Y, Lucarionite Z, Rayquaza's special Mega requirement, Red Orb, and Darkranite as appropriate. Do not assign a second held item.
